name: Gundlach's anole
desc: A common forest anole that eats small invertebrates. Young Puerto Rican boas feed mainly on anoles.
about: Anolis gundlachi, also commonly known as the yellow-chinned anole, Gundlach's anole, and the yellow-beard anole, is an oviparous, sexually dimorphic species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae.
